consent.title: Before we start
body: I'm an automated assistant and I can get things wrong: Rubén confirms everything in writing. What you type is sent to Google (Gemini) to generate the answer, so please don't include personal or client data.

If you accept, Rubén will keep this conversation for 90 days to review it and improve the service. It isn't linked to your name or email unless you give them to me so he can contact you. You can ask for it to be deleted at hola@rubenrosales.dev.

greeting: Hi, I'm Rubén Rosales's assistant. I do some groundwork for him: I work out what you need, explain how he works and, if you like, give you an indicative range.
bio: Rubén is an independent developer. Since 2019 he has been building software for small businesses: he automates processes, connects the tools you already use and applies AI where it really saves hours.

start.label: I have a project in mind
How much does something like this cost?

say:
Great. Three quick questions and I'll give you a range.

1/3 · What do you want to solve?

Rubén is an independent developer. Since 2019 he has been building software for small businesses: he automates processes, connects the tools you already use and applies AI where it really saves hours.
He works with a scope agreed in writing, deliveries every 1–2 weeks and support after deployment. You deal with him directly, with no intermediaries.
It depends a lot on the scope, so I'm not going to throw out a number at random.
If you tell me three things, I can give you an indicative range based on similar projects. Shall we?
Of course. Leave me your name and email and Rubén will write to you within 24 working hours, with everything we have discussed so far.

1. A 30-minute call to understand the problem (free).
2. A proposal with scope, timeline and a fixed price.
3. Development in deliveries you can test as you go.
4. Deployment, training and support.
You only pay for what is agreed in the proposal.
Timelines range from 2 to 16 weeks depending on the type of project. With three details I can give you a tighter range.
2/3 · What do you work with now?
3/3 · How many people are involved in this process?
Based on what you've told me, similar projects usually end up in this range:
It is a reference so you can tell whether it fits your budget, not a commitment. What next?
Thanks. With this Rubén can prepare a concrete proposal for you.
Shall I pass him the summary?
Good question. I'd rather not make up an answer: I'll pass it to Rubén as it is and he will reply.
Meanwhile, can I help you with any of this?

estimate.title: Indicative range
estimate.up: Integrating programs without an API, many special cases, messy data or very tight deadlines.
estimate.down: Starting with a single process, tools that already have an API, or reusing pieces from previous projects.
estimate.disclaimer: This is not a quote. It is a range based on similar projects; the real figure comes from a 30-minute call with Rubén and a written proposal.
